sources.snippet: CVCI 2026 (2026年第七届计算机视觉与计算智能国际会议) 是 AI 领域的学术会议。截稿日期：2025-11-10。检索类型：Ei Compendex,Scopus。出版方：SPIE。本页提供官网直达、投稿指南搜索及会议详情。

sources.title: PDF Cvci 2026 Cfp
sources.snippet: CVCI 2026 2026 7th International Conference on Computer Vision and Computational Intelligence (CVCI 2026) will be held in Hokkaido University, Japan during January 9-11, 2026. All accepted and registered papers can be published in the CVCI 2026 SPIE Conference Proceedings, which will be included in SPIE Digital Library and indexed by Ei Compendex, Scopus.
